description: Stand-in rubric for retrieval captions of NAIP tiles. The retrieval scorer (scorer.json) fills its one criterion; the judge is not called. Replace with Clay's captions and retrieval set (K-1).

criteria.name: Retrieval
criteria.description: The caption retrieves its own tile: among the tile and its 7 most Clay-similar look-alikes, the tile's reference caption is the most similar to the caption. Score = 4 / rank.

levels.1: Ranked 5th-8th: the caption fits the look-alikes as well as the tile.
levels.4: Ranked 1st: the caption singles out its tile.
